+## Message history (beta)
+
+For Numbers with hosted message storage, and teams enrolled in the message
+history beta, read stored conversations and messages with a server API key.
+Conversation commands need `chats:read`; message commands need
+`messages:read`. Client tokens are rejected before any request.
+
+```shell
+polymorfa chat list --session session_123 --kind direct
+polymorfa chat get +15551234567 --session session_123
+
+polymorfa message list \
+  --session session_123 \
+  --conversation +15551234567 \
+  --direction inbound \
+  --type text,image \
+  --since 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z \
+  --json
+
+polymorfa message get 740000000001 \
+  --session session_123 \
+  --conversation +15551234567
+```
+
+Lists return one page (default 50, `--limit` up to 100). `--max-items` follows
+later pages until that many items are collected. `--json` output includes
+`page.nextCursor` and `page.previousCursor`; pass one back with `--cursor` and
+the same filters. `message list` orders newest first; use `--order asc` for

+
+import {BaseCommand} from '../../base-command.js'
+import {renderChats} from '../../services/history.js'
+
+export default class ChatGet extends BaseCommand {
+  static override args = {
+    conversation: Args.string({
+      description: 'Conversation ID or E.164 phone number.',
+      required: true,
+    }),
+  }
+
+  static override description =
+    'Show one stored conversation (beta; requires chats:read).'

+  static override flags = {
+    session: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Messaging session ID.',
+      required: true,
+    }),
+  }
+
+  async run(): Promise<void> {
+    const {args, flags} = await this.parse(ChatGet)
+    const client = await this.messagingClient(flags, {

+  static override flags = {
+    'active-before': Flags.string({
+      description:
+        'Only conversations whose latest activity is before this RFC 3339 time.',
+    }),
+    'active-since': Flags.string({
+      description:
+        'Only conversations with activity at or after this RFC 3339 time.',
+    }),
+    cursor: Flags.string({
+      description:
+        'Continue from nextCursor. Repeat the same filters used for the earlier page.',
+    }),
+    kind: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Only conversations of this kind.',
+      options: ['direct', 'group', 'channel', 'broadcast'],
+    }),
+    limit: Flags.integer({

+      description:

+      description: 'Messaging session ID.',
+      required: true,
+    }),
+  }
+
+  async run(): Promise<void> {
+    const {flags} = await this.parse(ChatList)
+    const range = optionalTimeRange(
+      flags['active-since'],
+      flags['active-before'],
+    )
+    const client = await this.messagingClient(flags, {
+      serverApiKeyOnly: 'Message history',
+    })
+    const first = await client.chats.list(flags.session, {

+    })
+    const value = await collectHistory(first, flags['max-items'])
+    this.writeValue(value, renderChats(value.data), flags)
+  }

+import {Flags} from '@oclif/core'
+
+import {BaseCommand} from '../../base-command.js'
+import {optionalTimeRange} from '../../input/time.js'
+import {collectHistory, renderMessages} from '../../services/history.js'
+
+export default class MessageList extends BaseCommand {
+  static override description =
+    'List stored messages in one conversation, newest first (beta; requires messages:read and hosted message storage).'
+
+  static override examples = [
+    '<%= config.bin %> message list --session support-line --conversation +15550001111',
+    '<%= config.bin %> message list --session support-line --conversation 739182640518203 --direction inbound --type text,image --since 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z --json',
+  ]
+
+  static override flags = {
+    conversation: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Conversation ID or E.164 phone number.',
+      required: true,
+    }),
+    cursor: Flags.string({
+      description:
+        'Continue from nextCursor or previousCursor. Repeat the same filters used for the earlier page.',
+    }),
+    direction: Flags.string({
+      description: 'inbound: from contacts; outbound: sent by the Number.',
+      options: ['inbound', 'outbound'],
+    }),
+    limit: Flags.integer({
+      description: 'Messages per page (default 50).',
+      max: 100,
+      min: 1,
+    }),
+    'max-items': Flags.integer({
+      description: 'Follow later pages until this many messages are collected.',
+      max: 10_000,
+      min: 1,
+    }),
+    order: Flags.string({
+      description: 'desc: newest first (default); asc: oldest first.',
+      options: ['desc', 'asc'],
+    }),
+    session: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Messaging session ID.',
+      required: true,
+    }),
+    since: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Messages sent at or after this RFC 3339 time.',
+    }),
+    type: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Comma-separated message types, for example text,image.',
+    }),
+    until: Flags.string({
+      description: 'Messages sent before this RFC 3339 time.',
+    }),
+  }
+
+  async run(): Promise<void> {
+    const {flags} = await this.parse(MessageList)
+    const range = optionalTimeRange(flags.since, flags.until)
+    const types = flags.type
+      ?.split(',')
+      .map((value) => value.trim())
+      .filter((value) => value.length > 0)
+    const client = await this.messagingClient(flags, {
+      serverApiKeyOnly: 'Message history',
+    })
+    const first = await client.messages.list(
+      flags.session,
+      flags.conversation,
+      {
+        ...(flags.limit === undefined ? {} : {limit: flags.limit}),
+        ...(flags.cursor === undefined ? {} : {cursor: flags.cursor}),
+        ...(flags.order === undefined
+          ? {}
+          : {order: flags.order as 'asc' | 'desc'}),
+        ...(flags.direction === undefined
+          ? {}
+          : {direction: flags.direction as 'inbound' | 'outbound'}),
+        ...(types === undefined || types.length === 0 ? {} : {types}),
+        ...range,
+      },
+    )
+    const value = await collectHistory(first, flags['max-items'])
+    this.writeValue(value, renderMessages(value.data), flags)
+  }
+}

+import type {HistoryChat, HistoryMessage, HistoryPage} from '@polymorfa/sdk'
+
+export interface HistoryListValue<T> {
+  readonly data: readonly T[]
+  readonly page: {
+    readonly hasMore: boolean
+    readonly nextCursor: string | null
+    readonly previousCursor: string | null
+  }
+  readonly dataRegion: string | null
+  readonly metadata: {
+    readonly attempts: number
+    readonly requestId?: string
+    readonly status: number
+  }
+}
+
+/** Machine output for one history page; cursors are passed back unchanged. */
+export function historyListValue<T>(
+  page: HistoryPage<T>,
+  items: readonly T[] = page.items,
+  hasMore: boolean = page.hasMore,
+  nextCursor: string | null = page.nextCursor ?? null,
+): HistoryListValue<T> {
+  const metadata = page.response.metadata
+  return {
+    data: items,
+    page: {
+      hasMore,
+      nextCursor,
+      previousCursor: page.previousCursor ?? null,
+    },
+    dataRegion: page.dataRegion ?? null,
+    metadata: {
+      attempts: metadata.attempts,
+      ...(metadata.requestId === undefined
+        ? {}
+        : {requestId: metadata.requestId}),
+      status: metadata.status,
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+/** Follows nextCursor until maxItems or the last page. */
+export async function collectHistory<T>(
+  first: HistoryPage<T>,
+  maxItems: number | undefined,
+): Promise<HistoryListValue<T>> {
+  if (maxItems === undefined) return historyListValue(first)
+  const items: T[] = [...first.items]
+  let page: HistoryPage<T> = first
+  while (items.length < maxItems && page.hasMore) {
+    const next = await page.nextPage()
+    if (next === null) break
+    if (next.nextCursor !== undefined && next.nextCursor === page.nextCursor) {
+      throw new Error('The API returned the same cursor twice.')
+    }
+    page = next
+    items.push(...page.items)
+  }
+  const truncated = items.length > maxItems
+  return historyListValue(
+    first,
+    items.slice(0, maxItems),
+    truncated || page.hasMore,
+    truncated ? null : (page.nextCursor ?? null),
+  )
+}
+
+export function renderChats(chats: readonly HistoryChat[]): string {
